title: Port Build 7 ECR -1 to Build 8: Depart test not perfomed well
executive_summary: This change addresses a departure test result reporting problem in the onboard system where a failed departure test is incorrectly displayed after receiving a 1010 non-controlling command during the Begin Departure Test prompt, even though no new test was performed. The issue involves two requirements: L2R26 covers departure test result reporting, and L2R35 covers how the departure test prompt should behave during state changes. You need to test five scenarios with particular focus on two high-priority tests: L2R26:TC1 which checks what happens when 1010 is sent at the Begin Departure Test prompt after a passed test, and L2R26:TC2 which verifies the Depart Test key press at cutout after a passed test. The other three tests cover the departure flag toggle with brake interface, the initialization sequence, and the case where no new test has been performed since the previous pass. However, the qa.lead@enterprise.com has rejected the test recommendation, so this testing is on hold pending their review.

ecr_overview.title: Port Build 7 ECR -1 to Build 8: Depart test not perfomed well
ecr_overview.description:
When onboard is Displaying Begin Departure Test prompt, resulting by pressing Init key, and when 1010 is sent to go non-controlling, onboard is displaying Depart test as Failed

Scenario
-Make sure Depart test is passed
-Enable Depart flag (Toggle Brake interface from EBI)
-begin Initializing
-send 1010 "Command locomotive system state to Non-controlling" at Begin Depart Test prompt
-Press Depart test key at cutout and observe 2011 report
Observe Depart test shows depart test report as Failed even though no departure test is performed after prvious depart test is passed
